Hannah / team —

Attached is a refreshed MAP (BrightRetail_MAP_v3.pdf) that stitches together the evaluation milestones, approval steps, and the proposed signature cadence. Highlights:
- Evaluation window: 2-week production eval starting 2028-03-01; checkpoints at day 3 and day 10.
- Final go/no-go decision target: 2028-03-08 (internal exec signoff) so signatures can complete on 2028-03-10.
- Requested customer signature window: 48 hours after DocuSign arrives to meet a 2028-03-15 start date.

Ask: please confirm procurement lead and any internal approval gates on your side that could shift those dates (legal review, compliance, PO processing). If those are tight, propose alternate signature windows and we will align legal to accept minimal redlines to preserve start date.

I'm looping in Evelyn for onboarding readiness and Connor for the production eval plan so we can run the MAP runbook if we get the green.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee

Thanks Soojin — this is clear and helps a lot. A few items from procurement/legal:
1) Procurement needs a 72-hour minimum to issue a PO after we receive the final SOW (ours is a centralized process).
2) Our legal will want to run a final redline; turnaround is typically 3 business days unless we pre-clear the core terms.
3) Can you confirm the absolute latest date we can sign while still hitting a 2028-03-15 start? We might need to push the final decision one day earlier to accommodate our internal queue.

If you can get your legal to accept a narrow redline window (technical/operational edits only) we can commit to expedited review. Otherwise we risk slipping the start by one week.

Appreciate the MAP doc — will review and get back with PO/Legal contacts this afternoon.

Best,

- Legal is comfortable with a constrained "technical-only" redline carveout limited to schedule, IP that affects runtime telemetry, and data handling clarifications. No commercial rate or indemnity changes allowed.
- We'll accept comments on technical sections only; any changes outside that scope will require exec review and will likely push timelines.
- I'll attach the redlined doc and a short checklist for your procurement team to include with the DocuSign packet.

If you can confirm BrightRetail acknowledges the limited scope by replying to this thread, Legal will pre-approve DocuSign routing and the sign order.

Subject: Final go/no-go checklist and signature plan (target start 2028-03-15)

Hannah / Leo / procurement —

Thanks for the quick responses. Per Markus, legal will accept a technical-only redline envelope. To keep 2028-03-15 as the start, here's the final operational plan and required actions:

1) 2028-03-01: Prod eval begins (Connor lead). Day 3 checkpoint for performance validation.
2) 2028-03-06: Internal exec go/no-go (Evelyn to confirm readiness and any open on-call commitments).
3) 2028-03-08: Customer-side final decision deadline. Please confirm in this thread that procurement and legal can sign-off by this date.
4) 2028-03-10: DocuSign routing begins (Redwood signs first, then BrightRetail). 48-hour customer signature window.
5) 2028-03-15: Target production start (onboarding sprint day 1).

Required from BrightRetail to meet dates:
- Acknowledgement of the technical-only redline scope in reply to this thread.
- Procurement commit to issue PO within 72 hours of receiving an executed SOW.
- PO file or PO number sent to contracts@redwoodinference.com after signature.

We will attach a short signoff checklist to the DocuSign packet and pre-route the sign order to accelerate completion. Evelyn — can you confirm the onboarding team will be ready for a 03-15 start if the signatures complete on 03-10?

If anything above changes, flag immediately so we can adjust the eval ramp.

Thanks,
Soojin
